extracted.name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
extracted.description: A delicious honey garlic glazed salmon dish. Salmon is covered in a sweet and salty glaze in this recipe that is easy enough for a beginner.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Season salmon fillets on both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook salmon fillets until flesh flakes easily with a fork, 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Combine honey, water, brown sugar, sriracha sauce, soy sauce, and garlic in a small pot over medium heat; bring to a boil. Cook, stirring frequently, until glaze is thick and smooth, 5 to 7 minutes.
